$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # variants
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...

$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # mark more's cell, and change what it prints
$ go test  # variants
    script/twice/variant/more: The do/ tree gains a second output.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The cell is frozen by its known gap, variant/more/gaps line 1: "echo b1 is three, in digits. Waits on sheets#3."
        Its committed files record today's behavior, and the run now produces different ones:
        variant/more/out/echo/b.txt differs (-committed +got):
        - b1 three
        + b1 3
        If the gap is closed, remove the line, and the next update writes the cell. If the wrong behavior changed shape, delete the cell's files, and the next update writes them.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank/echo
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/more
                --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/more/echo
FAIL
[exit 1]
